chunks: Do you think the men of the cave and Ar-Raqim were so strange among Our signs?

key_terms.وَالرَّقِيمِ: And Ar-Raqim (a place or inscription associated with the cave)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the People of the Cave as a sign of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a rhetorical challenge to those who doubt the reality of divine power, framing the Sleepers' preservation not as a myth but as a definitive 'Ayah' (sign) demonstrating God's ability to resurrect and protect the faithful. It underscores the theological concept of 'Ghaybah' (occultation) and endurance, linking the Sleepers' long concealment in the cave to the Imam's hidden presence during periods of persecution. This narrative reinforces the believer's trust in divine timing and the eventual manifestation of truth.
